label: Road repair & safety barrier
tagline: Marked disposed, but not everything was confirmed.

grievance.title: Damaged road surface and broken roadside barrier near Sector 18
grievance.text:
The road near Sector 18 has several deep potholes and a damaged roadside barrier. This has created a safety risk for daily commuters. I request:
1. Repair of the damaged road surface.
2. Replacement of the damaged roadside barrier.
3. Confirmation once both works are completed.

response.text: The matter was examined by the concerned authority. Inspection has been carried out and necessary road repair work has been initiated through the implementing agency. The grievance is disposed.
